note: Open headline incidents, read by data_integrity.MovementInvariant. A slice listed under `open` reports FAIL regardless of what today's numbers say — that is the point: the movement formula's own inputs (elapsed span, arriving rows, baseline age) all widen over time, so an incident left to the calendar closes itself. Do not hand-edit this file. Close an incident with `python3 data_integrity.py --close-incident <slice> --reviewed-by ... --reason ... --rows ... --replacement-jobs ... --replacement-entries ...`, which is the only path that also writes the replacement baseline.
